description: Field validation parity cases generated by @json-render/core runValidation. Each case: { "name", "config": ValidationConfig { checks?: [{ type, args?, message }], validateOn?, enabled? }, "value"?, "state", "expected": { valid, errors: string[], checks: [{ type, valid, message }] } }. expected = runValidation(config, { value, stateModel: state }). A case without "value" means value === undefined (unbound / missing). Check args are resolved with resolvePropValue against state before the check runs; enabled is evaluated with evaluateVisibility and, when false, yields { valid: true, errors: [], checks: [] }. Unknown check types pass. url uses the WHATWG URL parser (new URL(value) must not throw).

cases.name: pattern: empty string vs optional pattern
url: with port, path and query
matches: missing value and missing other (undefined === undefined)
matches: no args compares to undefined
lessThan: numeric string vs number coerces
lessThan: non-numeric string vs number fails
greaterThan: end date equal to start
requiredIf: condition empty string, value empty
enabled literal false is ignored (core only checks a truthy enabled)
